about: The painted landmarks seen past a map's edge (the engine's Vista, docs/art/atmosphere.md 'Vistas'; plan 8.4): one look-P painting each on a plain white ground (tools/art/build_vistas.py --generate [--only id ...] queues them on the local image service with art/prompts/vista_preamble.txt), cut out of the white into art/vistas/<id>.png. size: the painting's size in pixels for the image service; height: the cut-out's height; take: which take is used (the paintings are kept under the asset root, vistas/<id>_<take>.png); place: the travel place the landmark stands at (data/travel), `within` how far from it on the travel art it shows (a fraction of the map), distance, height_world, sink: its place in the world (see tools/art/build_vistas.py places).

wickermoor_oak.prompt: The Oak of Many Faces and the clocktower of Wickermoor seen from many miles away: a colossal gnarled bare oak whose trunk and branches are studded with tiny pale screaming faces, beside a crooked slate-roofed clocktower with a glowing round clock face, a huddle of crooked leaning roofs with orange windows at their feet, one tall narrow silhouette.

crooked_house.prompt: The Crooked House on its hill, seen from many miles away: a huge Victorian manor whose every line leans and bends askew, crooked gables, leaning chimneys and a bent tower, bruised violet walls with a few warm orange windows, standing on a small grassy hill, one tall silhouette.

foxwillow_windmill.prompt: A tall five-storey wooden windmill with great crooked sails and a glowing amber window near its top, standing in golden cornfields at dusk, a jack-o'-lantern scarecrow at its foot, seen from many miles away as one tall silhouette.

dawns_gate_monastery.prompt: A stone monastery with a tall bell tower and a single blood-red glowing window high on a snowy cliff above a river valley, three jagged rock spires like howling wolves behind it, a red moon rising, seen from many miles away.

murkwater_riverboat.prompt: A big paddle riverboat with two tall black smokestacks and strings of yellow gaslights, moored in black swamp water among twisted cypress trees hung with moss, jinx-purple lanterns glowing, seen from many miles away.

skitterdeep_headframe.prompt: A rusty timber mine headframe with a great winding wheel on a bare rocky hill, a sickly green light glowing from the shaft and lamplight in a few dusty windows, rubble and ore carts at its foot, seen from many miles away as one tall silhouette.

memorys_rest.prompt: A pale porcelain-white sanatorium with a slender spire on a small island in a dark storm-blue lake, mint-green lit windows, a faint pale glow rising from the water beneath it, seen from many miles away.

hartsblight_canopy.prompt: A towering canopy of giant glowing toxic-teal mushrooms and rotting magenta fungus trees with drifting spores and emerald lights between the caps, seen from many miles away as one broad silhouette.

maidenmist_spires.prompt: A walled cemetery of tall pale needle-like spires and leaning tombstones in thick silver fog, balefire orange glowing among the graves, seen from many miles away.

rowans_rise_wicker_man.prompt: Rowan's Rise seen from many miles away: a bare round hilltop crowned by a colossal Wicker Man, a giant humanoid effigy of woven willow withies with both arms raised to the sky, its chest and limbs hollow cages glowing amber from inside, a ring of small bonfires round the crown of the hill throwing orange light, dry grass slopes below, one tall narrow silhouette.

crooked_tree_wytchwood.prompt: The Crooked Tree over the Wytchwood seen from many miles away: a colossal gnarled bare oak standing alone on a mound above a black-green forest, its trunk twisted and leaning, a huge crooked grin carved in the bark and glowing amber, a faint warm glow at its roots from a barrow mouth, embers drifting up, a few crows, one tall broad silhouette.
